notes: Evidence paths are relative to the output folder. The plugin is not obfuscated; plain decompilation is enough.

findings.description: Uploads batches of sightings to https://echovault.gg on /v1/ingest; each request is signed with an HMAC sent in X-Echo-* headers.

Each sighting holds the player's Content ID, name, home and current world, territory and x/y/z position, job, level, Free Company tag, appearance data, Account ID, title, Grand Company, equipment and weapon models, mount, online status, duty and online state, with the time it was seen.

evidence.contains: public record Sighting(ulong ContentId, string Name, uint HomeWorldId, uint CurrentWorldId, ushort TerritoryId, float X, float Y, float Z, byte JobId, byte Level, string? FcTag, string? CustomizeBase64, DateTimeOffset SeenAtUtc
ulong AccountId = 0uL, ushort TitleId = 0, byte GrandCompany = 0, List<EquipSlot>? Equipment = null, ulong MainhandModel = 0uL, ulong OffhandModel = 0uL
ushort MountId = 0, ushort OnlineStatusId = 0, ushort DutyId = 0, bool? IsOnline = null
nowUtc, player.Source, player.AccountId, player.TitleId, player.GrandCompany, player.Equipment

findings.description: Fills each sighting of a player around the user with that player's Account ID, read from the game's character data.
Fills each sighting from the game's character lists with that player's Account ID, read from the list entry.
Records the players around the user from the object table, with their position and the models and dyes of their equipment.
Records players from the game's friend list, Free Company, linkshell and cross-world linkshell member lists, Novice Network member and mentor lists, and from Player Search results.
Records the players behind Party Finder listings and any player the user right-clicks.

evidence.contains: private void OnListing(IPartyFinderListing listing, IPartyFinderListingEventArgs args)

findings.description: Each batch also carries the user's own territory and x/y/z position.

evidence.contains: public record ReporterSelf(ushort TerritoryId, float X, float Y, float Z);
public record IngestBatch(int ProtocolVersion, string PluginVersion, ReporterSelf Reporter, List<Sighting> Sightings, bool AutoSearchEnabled = false);

findings.description: Capturing players around the user, character lists, Party Finder and right-clicked players, and Player Search results is on by default; automatic Player Search is off by default.

evidence.contains: public sealed record PersistedSettings(bool CaptureEnabled = true, bool SocialCaptureEnabled = true, bool NameCacheCaptureEnabled = true, bool SearchCaptureEnabled = true, bool ContextMenuLinkEnabled = true, bool AutoSearchEnabled = false

findings.description: When automatic search is turned on, runs the game's Player Search by itself; its results are captured like other Player Search results.
Requests from the server, for the user's world, a list of territories with counts of new players and sightings over 7 days and the hours since each was last swept.

findings.description: Links players to public profile pages at https://echovault.gg/p/<world>/<name>, offered as "View on EchoVault" in the right-click menu.
